whoTheyAre.summary: The live source identifies Foodo in Benin and ties the record to Foodo (fod). Glottolog independently identifies Foodo in Benin and Togo, while a dedicated Journal of West African Languages grammar sketch describes Foodo as a Guang linguistic island in northern Benin.

claims.text: The live PeopleGroups.org record PG012320 reports PEID 12320, display name Foodo, country Benin and primary language Foodo (fod).
Glottolog identifies Foodo with glottocode food1238 and ISO 639-3 code fod and lists Benin and Togo among its countries.
Independent linguistic sources identify Foodo as a Guang language, and the dedicated 2009 grammar sketch describes it as a linguistic island among Gur languages in northern Benin.
claims.interpretationNote: This is linguistic/geographic context, not a statement about the character, receptivity or socioeconomic condition of Foodo people.
